Asset type: production environment hero artwork for a Vietnamese xianxia RPG sect interface.
Primary request: a magnificent Chinese immortal cultivation sect on a mountain above a sea of clouds, inspired by an ornate navy and gold RPG interface reference. Generate only painted environment art, no UI.
Scene: layered ivory and dark blue tiled pagodas on steep rocky terraces, elegant stairway leading toward a grand central sect hall, hanging plain blue silk banners WITHOUT letters or symbols, pink peach blossom branches at far corners, distant jagged blue peaks, waterfalls disappearing into clouds. Bright soft morning light, crisp roofs and airy mist. The buildings occupy center and right, the upper left is calmer sky and clouds to permit a real title overlay. Wide landscape 3:2, balanced painterly fantasy illustration, premium game key art, navy blue, ivory stone, pale blue clouds and restrained antique gold details.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI or framing, no people. Full bleed landscape.
